Loop gains above max(2%, spread) in both passes: False; repeated timing regressions: []; repeated allocation growth above 0.5%: []. All controls retained; no full lanes or favorable recollection.

assessmentPolicy.acceptance: Require loop gains beyond max(2%, retained spread) in both passes, no repeated control timing regression beyond that bound, and no repeated complete-job allocation growth above 0.5%.
assessmentPolicy.rationale: Operation-layer exact built-in integer Add reaches the existing AddExactIntegers helper directly. Actual context/governor/reclamation pool, signed payload fees, observation, opcode/compound checkpoints, source spans, right/left operand order and rich/non-add/async/generator fallbacks remain. No main-switch growth, representation change, guest-state cache or reduced fees.
assessmentPolicy.controls: Empty, positional/keyword/method calls, full stable sort/output and ASCII pipeline; preserve all seven canonical cases.
assessmentPolicy.semanticGates: Twelve independently pinned executable ownership/checkpoint checks and four CPython goldens, original actual-context/cell/receiver/host/lease/augmented-target/generator tests, and full matching Debug/VM Release suites per producer before timing.
assessmentPolicy.nativeCode: Keep every emitted native body/tier, inline summary and call target for the operator bridge, semantic fallback, integer helper/ownership, main/value/control execution and guards. No size-speed forecast.
assessmentPolicy.genuineAsync: Unchanged genuine awaited operator/target paths preserve their actual context, host effects and lifetime.
